name: Metaballs
doc: 8 to 16 blobs on slow seeded orbits, each one's radius following its own spectrum band; their field merges at a soft threshold with a glowing edge and colours blend where they meet. Every onset sends a ring out from one blob, which swells as the ring leaves.

palette.doc: each blob takes one position along the palette; stop 0 tints the background

react.doc: how much each blob's band swells it

speed.doc: orbit speed (positions are closed-form in time: keep it fixed, binding it to a signal makes the blobs jump)

pulse.doc: onset rings: speed and strength (0 = off)
